  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The "Shallow checkout" step sets head_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" and always runs shallow_fetch --depth=200 origin "${head_commit}" "${main_refspec}". When the stale merge-ref fallback has created a local merge commit (outcome=merged_locally reason=not_refreshed merge=183e0669...), that commit does not exist on origin, so the fetch fails with "upload-pack: not our ref" and the job exits before any test runs.
  WHY: The affected test jobs fail and lint fails because it depends on them, so final CI stays red whenever GitHub does not recompute refs/pull/9702/merge. The same pair also appears at lines 2551/2564 and 4153/4166. Severity is disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT, openai_gpt-6-luna said BLOCKER and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave none, so the highest (BLOCKER→critical) is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 also says no hunk in this PR causes it, that the editor should not change PR code for it, and that it belongs in a separate issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The diff contains no measured step timings and no job-duration comparison showing these were the slowest steps or that tests-hooks-and-orchestrator had the most headroom. The hard constraints are met: names and bodies are unchanged, timeout-minutes is not raised (test_source_and_target_timeouts_are_unchanged at lines 4539-4546) and no job was added.   PROBLEM: In final-CI run 45105217555, scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh reported outcome=merged_locally reason=not_refreshed merge=183e0669506b05c8981a5bbbfb74cb31cead8e85. Line 799 then fetches that runner-only commit from origin, which fails with "upload-pack: not our ref" on all three tries. Shards 8, 10, 17, 19 and 22 of tests-system-python fail this way, and lint fails because it depends on them. The same workflow was green on the previous head 11dc45a0, and no hunk in this PR causes the failure.
  WHY: Every job with this step fails whenever refs/pull/9702/merge is not recomputed, so final CI stays red whatever the PR code does. Logs for static-checks, tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and tests-release-and-log-analysis were not available, so their cause is unconfirmed. The editor should not change PR code; a branch update or a final-CI re-run should clear it. The checkout-step fix belongs in a separate issue.
